<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>EXHIBIT 8.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">[DATE] </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Two Pennsylvania Plaza, </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">New York, NY 10121 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Ladies and Gentlemen: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We have acted as U.S. tax
counsel to Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., a Nevada corporation (&#8220;<B>MSG Sports</B>&#8221;), in connection with the Distribution as described in the Form 10 Registration Statement of MSGS Spinco, Inc. (&#8220;<B>Controlled</B>&#8221;)
effective [&#149;]. Capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the officer&#8217;s certificate to us from MSG Sports, dated [&#149;] (the &#8220;<B>Officer&#8217;s Certificate</B>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In rendering our opinion, we have examined and relied upon the accuracy and completeness of the facts set forth in the Officer&#8217;s
Certificate and such other documents as we have deemed necessary or appropriate. In addition, we have relied upon the representation letter to us from James L. Dolan. In connection with this opinion, we have assumed that the Contribution and the
Distribution will be consummated in the manner described in the Officer&#8217;s Certificate, and we have made the assumptions described in Exhibit E attached thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In rendering our opinion, we have considered the applicable provisions of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the
&#8220;<B>Code</B>&#8221;), Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder, pertinent judicial authorities, interpretive rulings of the Internal Revenue Service, and such other authorities as we have deemed appropriate under the circumstances. All such
authorities are subject to change, and any of such changes could apply retroactively. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Based upon the foregoing, we are of the opinion
that under current law, </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(1) The Contribution and Distribution, taken together, will qualify as a reorganization under
Section&nbsp;368(a)(1)(D) of the Code; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(2) Neither MSG Sports nor Controlled will recognize gain or loss upon the Contribution; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(3) MSG Sports will not recognize gain or loss upon the Distribution under Section&nbsp;355(c) or Section&nbsp;361(c) of the Code; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(4) Stockholders of MSG Sports will not recognize gain or loss upon the Distribution under Section&nbsp;355(a) of the Code, and no amount will
be included in such shareholders&#8217; income, except in respect of cash received in lieu of fractional shares of Controlled. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Our opinion is expressly conditioned upon the assumptions and statements of reliance set
forth above. We express no other opinion as to the tax consequences (including any applicable state, local or foreign tax consequences) of the transactions referred to herein or in the Officer&#8217;s Certificate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">Very truly yours, </P>
